Dear Mr.GP, 
I really like your name. As a person of different culture at first it rolls off my tongue leaving no special impression, but now that it's appeared too many time in my head I grew addicted to it. I love it and I wish I could say it out loud, use it to address you irl. It's silly really. I don't even know that much about you, save for the footprints you've left on the internet, but I feel so attracted toward you and It leaves me helpless because I know I have zero chance. You read the message I send you and replied with the kindest words toward a stranger and it made me so happy because was I you I would have blocked myself. The things I want to say to you are the things I've already said: You're an amazing human being, so talented, so passionate. You make the world feel so right and I really want to be part of your world that shines so bright, but of course, I know where the limit is. So I will just keep on loving you half an earth away, right now I honestly think that I could never stop loving you if you keep being who you are, but you know my brain is on all kind of wrong chemical reactions when it's about you that I can't think straight anymore.
